reviews.rationale: I compared the entire XXI.1 line on PDF90 with the submitted source, English, source note and empty footnotes. The opening circuit/journey verb is compatible with traveled on: actual Dillmann cols999-1000 supplies circumire/circumcirca movement, while Charles p52 note21 specifically flags the rare journey sense. The destination and negative made/done clause are preserved. This acceptance is of the selected printed line, not proof of a uniform manuscript reading.

The complete PDF90 unit retains both printed negatives, heaven above and earth established/founded, followed by the unprepared/terrifying place. Actual Dillmann col238 supports the firm/founded range. The source matches the displayed edition signs; the English neither turns the negatives into objects seen nor invents a completed creation. Terrifying sight is an acceptable idiomatic rendering of the terrifying work/phenomenon phrase. The note accurately distinguishes the selected editorial constitution from inherited OCR.

I inspected the complete PDF90-to92 span, including the daggered additional word, the independently readable together expression, great-mountain comparison and burning continuation. The submitted source/English/uncertainty record does not hide that extra word or substitute an inherited OCR reading. However, I cannot independently establish a secure lexical rendering for the selected daggered token; Charles p52 note37 itself presents corruption and alternatives rather than an assured reading. The literal English uncertainty and explicit hold are honest critical treatment, not an accepted publication translation. This is a real unresolved token, not cured by seven stars or mountain context.

The complete PDF92 question has sin/offence, passive binding, and a second why/for-what clause about being left here. Actual Dillmann cols621-622,747-748 and1205-1206 support the offence/binding/leaving ranges. The direct-speech English preserves both questions and adds no motive or doctrinal explanation. The submitted note and empty footnotes introduce no unresolved critical substitution.

I checked the whole PDF92 unit against source, English, note and footnote. Uriel, one of the holy angels, being with the speaker, guiding the speaker, and both personal interrogatives remain. Actual Dillmann cols375-376 supports asking,1245-1246 investigation/inquiry, and1255 eager concern or studium. Combining inquiry plus eager concern as inquiring so eagerly is disclosed and defensible, not a claim that one printed verb vanished. The selected guide-me reading is retained; Charles note9 is not silently adopted as a replacement.

I inspected the whole PDF92 unit, its count-word detail and Charles apparatus note18. The submitted literal source uncertainty replaces exactly the unresolved first fidel, and the English correspondingly does not assert the whole count word. Actual Dillmann cols575-578 supports number/count semantics,721 the ten-thousand range, and955 year, but none of those photographs can certify the first selected Charles glyph or its vocalic order. I therefore cannot approve inherited ኈ or lift the transcription hold. Years is explicitly disclosed as Charles Greek-assisted emendation from ዓለም, not independently proved Ethiopic manuscript evidence. I did not inspect/adopt Dillmann1851 and do not inherit the author's personally-compared claim as my own.

I checked the entire long PDF92 unit rather than its opening only. Another more terrifying place, burning/blazing fire, the split/chasm reaching the abyss, great descending pillars of fire, and inability to see its extent/size or estimate it are represented. Actual Dillmann cols185,415,649-650,957,701-703 and377 support the chasm/abyss/blazing/pillar/seeing-or-estimating/inability ranges. The English singular into it is an idiomatic referent to the chasm/abyss complex, not a newly specified destination or independent cosmographic claim. The bracketed duplicate seeing verb is retained in source and its nonduplication in English is explicitly explained by the footnote, consistent with Charles note39. No bottomless claim is added.

The complete short PDF92 unit is an exclamatory how construction with terror and an additional painful/afflictive visual quality. Actual Dillmann cols71-72 confirms the pain/suffering range. The English keeps both qualities and the act of looking; the footnote is a restrained lexical clarification. It does not replace painful with merely magnificent or import a second scene.

I checked both PDF92 and94: attribution to Uriel and the with-me description, Enoch address, fear/dismay question, selected first-person answer, reason involving this terrifying place, and painful-torment phrase all remain. Actual Dillmann cols1119-1120,1351-1352,461-462,1207-1210 and247-248 support dismay/fear, before/front/sight and affliction/torment. Charles p55 note46, personally viewed on PDF93, and p56 note4 explicitly disclose restoring/repositioning the answer word. The English and footnote accurately follow that selected editorial text without claiming unanimous manuscript evidence. My initial source-first ledger's provisional heaven-like observation was mistaken and is expressly withdrawn: PDF94 reads the pain/torment phrase, not a heaven comparison. I did not use the facing Greek as an English oracle.

I checked the full numbered10 on PDF94 through the double stop beforeXXII against all submitted fields. The place, angels' prison, there rather than a silent here-normalization, holding, and forever are preserved. Actual Dillmann cols909-910 supports the prison/binding range. The source note appropriately limits its claim to the displayed source and does not rely on inherited acceptance; I likewise rely on this exact pass.

scope: Exact author v2 ten-row Chapter21 packet only. Eight accepts and two substantive holds; not chapter publication approval, all108 approval, manuscript certification, or human/provider-model review.
